name: Bulk purchase order action
whenToUse: Apply one batch action across many purchase order ids at once instead of acting on a single PO (mutating).

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```
